messages:
nora (product): quick heads-up: new convo about invoice UX for org pages. Two issues surfaced in customer calls: (1) export format preference (CSV bulk vs PDF single invoices) and (2) how invoices should group for org view vs project view on mobile. figma: https://figma.com/file/unique-invoice-mock
adrian (design): noted. for org default we should surface bulk CSV export in the toolbar (admins want ledgers). keep PDF per-row in overflow for legal-ready invoices. mobile: collapse groups under month headers with a single group-level download CTA. this keeps the header scannable.
kai (frontend): implementation notes: CSV bulk can be generated server-side; client triggers job and polls job_id. For mobile groups we'll virtualize groups instead of rows to reduce DOM churn. sample polling + debounce:
```
POST /api/billing/export -> {job_id}
poll /api/jobs/:id ?delay=1500
```
Sensible backoff avoids hammering.
sana (a11y): bulk export toast should include keyboard accessible link to job status and screen-reader announcement: "Bulk export started, X invoices will be included." For group headings make sure they are buttons (`role=button`) and have aria-expanded states. Also ensure month headers have clear landmarks.
omar (eng): backend: adding CSV bundle endpoint and PDF streaming per-invoice. we'll add rate limits and a batch-zip endpoint for toolbar CSV+PDF combo. event names: `billing.export.start`, `billing.invoice.download`. We'll include email notification when zip is ready.
liz (data): small sample from support logs: customers asked for CSV export 42% of the time in org-level use cases; PDFs 60% in project-level support flows. suggests org default should be CSV bulk + visible per-group download. will run an A/B: variant A = toolbar CSV primary, B = toolbar PDF primary. metric: time-to-find-invoice, support-start, export-success-rate.
deploy-bot: deploy_check: bulk_export endpoint flagged quota header missing in spec.
nora (product): agreement: org default = toolbar bulk CSV + group-level PDF in overflow; project default = PDF per-row with clearer invoice metadata. mobile: use month group collapse with group-level actions. adrian please mock mobile group header states. kai+omar, can you scope telemetry + API surface? liz will own metrics. sana please draft a11y checklist for groups and bulk flows.
adrian (design): will post frames in ~3h. microcopy: toolbar CTA = "Export visible invoices (CSV)"; group CTA = "Download month (PDF)"; per-row = "Download invoice (PDF)". also change token column label to "Compute tokens (est.)" and add hover helper text.
kai (frontend): ok. will implement group collapse with keyboard support and aria details. will lazy-load invoice rows inside open group.
sana (a11y): checklist: 1) bulk export toast ARIA-live polite with job link 2) group headers keyboard focus 3) per-row download has aria-label with month+amount 4) table summaries announced on navigation. will post checklist soon.
omar (eng): adding endpoints: /billing/export (POST) returns job_id, /billing/job/:id (GET) returns status+download_url; also /billing/invoice/:id/pdf. will include X-RateLimit headers as deploy-bot requested.
liz (data): will run two-week pilot on 10k orgs. dashboards: export_clicks_by_variant, pdf_vs_csv_downloads, support_invoices_missing. baseline csv/pdf ratios exported Friday.
nora (product): great. follow-ups: adrian post Figma + mobile states, omar PR for endpoints, kai implement UI with lazy group hydrate, sana a11y pass, liz dashboard. sync Wed 10:30. thanks everyone :sparkles:
